sentences.en: For the past few weeks, we've been listening to all the stories you sent us about your dads.
sentences.zh: 过去几周，我们一直在听你们发来的关于父亲的故事。

sentences.en: We wanted to know about the times your father opened up and showed you his emotions.
sentences.zh: 我们想了解你们的父亲敞开心扉、向你们流露情感的时刻。

sentences.en: There is exactly one moment in my life when my father opened up to me.
sentences.zh: 在我的人生中，父亲向我敞开心扉的时刻只有一次。

sentences.en: My father's generation is one that doesn't express much.
sentences.zh: 我父亲那一代人不太会表达情感。

sentences.en: And the only time we ever talk of love is at the end of a phone call.
sentences.zh: 我们唯一谈论爱的时候，是在电话快挂断时。

sentences.en: He'll say, like, love you.
sentences.zh: 他会说，比如，爱你。

sentences.en: I think he had a really hard time communicating what was going on inside of him.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他很难表达内心真实的想法。

sentences.en: So many of you told us your dad didn't open up very often.
sentences.zh: 你们中有很多人告诉我们，父亲很少敞开心扉。

sentences.en: These moments you shared, they were fleeting.
sentences.zh: 你们分享的这些时刻，都是转瞬即逝的。

sentences.en: They were on the heels of some big life event.
sentences.zh: 它们往往发生在一些重大人生事件之后。

sentences.en: And some of you didn't see your dad become emotional until the end of his life.
sentences.zh: 你们中有些人直到父亲生命尽头才看到他流露情感。

sentences.en: But when it did happen, oh boy.
sentences.zh: 但当那一刻真的发生时，天哪。

sentences.en: I
sentences.zh: 我

sentences.en: don't know if this is the kind of expression of love that you're looking for, but it's the only way my dad was ever able to tell me he loved me in a meaningful way.
sentences.zh: 不知道这是否是你所期待的那种爱的表达，但这确实是我父亲唯一一次能以有意义的方式告诉我他爱我。

sentences.en: One time, my dad silently walked over to the record player and put on a Patsy Cline record.
sentences.zh: 有一次，父亲默默地走到唱片机前，放了一张帕齐·克莱恩的唱片。

sentences.en: And he chose the song, I Fall to Pieces.
sentences.zh: 他选了那首《我心破碎》（I Fall to Pieces）。

sentences.en: Then he picked me up and hugged me to him.
sentences.zh: 然后他抱起我，把我紧紧搂在怀里。

sentences.en: And he slowly turned me around and around.
sentences.zh: 他带着我慢慢地转圈。

sentences.en: And I listened to the words, I fall to pieces each time I see you again.
sentences.zh: 我听着歌词：每次见到你，我都会心碎。

sentences.en: I fall to pieces each time someone speaks your name.
sentences.zh: 每次有人提起你的名字，我都会心碎。

sentences.en: And it struck me the most intensely I've ever felt it, that this was how he could tell me how he felt.
sentences.zh: 那一刻我强烈地感受到，这就是他表达情感的方式。

sentences.en: And it helped me to know that beneath the silence that I had always experienced with him
sentences.zh: 这让我明白，在他一直以来的沉默之下，

sentences.en: was a person, a man who was aching with love for me, but he just didn't know how to express it.
sentences.zh: 藏着一个人，一个对我爱得深沉却不知如何表达的男人。

sentences.en: When my dad was 58, he was diagnosed with stage 4 metastatic melanoma.
sentences.zh: 父亲58岁时，被诊断出患有四期转移性黑色素瘤。

sentences.en: Throughout the whole process, it remained rather matter-of-fact.
sentences.zh: 整个治疗过程中，他表现得相当冷静。

sentences.en: More bad news, more tests, more chemo.
sentences.zh: 更多的坏消息，更多的检查，更多的化疗。

sentences.en: And one day, he and I were in his hospital room and the news was on the TV and a report came on that there was new research showing cures for melanoma.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我们在医院病房里，电视上正在播放新闻，报道说有关于黑色素瘤治疗的新研究。

sentences.en: And everyone was real excited about that.
sentences.zh: 每个人都为此感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And my dad threw a fit like a toddler and showed me the raw emotion and frustration of the fact that he was dying.
sentences.zh: 但我父亲却像个孩子一样大发雷霆，向我展示了他面对死亡时那种原始的情绪和挫败感。

sentences.en: That has stayed with me all these years later.
sentences.zh: 多年过去了，那一幕一直留在我的脑海里。

sentences.en: And as I reach closer and closer to the age he was when he died, I think often of the vulnerability that he showed.
sentences.zh: 随着我越来越接近他去世时的年纪，我经常想起他展现出的那种脆弱。

sentences.en: And even if it wasn't that often, how important it was for him and for me.
sentences.zh: 即使那样的时刻并不多，但对他和我来说，都意义重大。

sentences.en: Look, not everyone had a quiet, unemotional dad.
sentences.zh: 听着，并不是每个人的父亲都是沉默寡言、不流露情感的。

sentences.en: We had plenty of stories about fathers who said, I love you all the time, who said how proud they were, who opened up about what they were going through.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了很多故事，讲述父亲们总是说“我爱你”，表达他们的骄傲，并倾诉他们的心声。

sentences.en: But what was common between every story we heard is that those peeks into your dad's world, they really meant something.
sentences.zh: 但我们听到的每个故事都有一个共同点：那些窥见父亲内心世界的瞬间，真的意义非凡。

sentences.en: One of my earliest memories with my dad is sitting in the car and a Sade song came on and he started crying.
sentences.zh: 我关于父亲最早的记忆之一，是坐在车里，电台放起莎黛（Sade）的歌，他开始哭泣。

sentences.en: And I asked him why he was crying, what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我问他为什么哭，发生了什么事。

sentences.en: And he said it was just reminding him of, well, he was waiting for my mom when he was living in Boston, going to grad school, and she was back in Philadelphia.
sentences.zh: 他说这让他想起，嗯，他在波士顿读研时等待我母亲，而她当时还在费城。

sentences.en: And he was in love with her and she didn't know yet that she was in love with him.
sentences.zh: 他爱着她，而她当时还不知道自己也爱着他。

sentences.en: And he was just waiting for her.
sentences.zh: 他就在那里等着她。

sentences.en: And he would play Sade and just cry, thinking about her and missing her.
sentences.zh: 他会放着莎黛的歌，一边想念她，一边哭泣。

sentences.en: And from that memory on, every single time a Sade song comes on, my dad starts to cry.
sentences.zh: 从那次记忆开始，每次听到莎黛的歌，父亲就会开始哭。

sentences.en: And what a gift it is, speaking a little emotional right now, what a gift it is to have the most steady man in my life teach me how to be vulnerable,
sentences.zh: 这真是一份礼物，我现在说起来都有点激动，能让生命中最稳重的人教我如何变得脆弱，这真是一份礼物，

sentences.en: how to cry in front of people you love.
sentences.zh: 教我如何在所爱之人面前哭泣。

sentences.en: You can't get a chance to have your father open up to you every day.
sentences.zh: 你不可能每天都有机会让父亲向你敞开心扉。

sentences.en: When I did get my chance, it was the kind of moment that made me feel like maybe, just maybe, we would be okay.
sentences.zh: 当我得到那个机会时，那一刻让我觉得，也许，只是也许，我们一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: It was a really meaningful way that he chose to connect with me that I'll never forget.
sentences.zh: 他选择以那种非常有意义的方式与我建立联系，我永远不会忘记。

sentences.en: And it's had such a lasting impact on me.
sentences.zh: 它对我产生了深远的影响。

sentences.en: I always appreciated him sharing that with me.
sentences.zh: 我一直很感激他与我分享这些。

sentences.en: It meant a lot to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我意义重大。

sentences.en: I'm unbelievably grateful for that gift.
sentences.zh: 我无比感激这份礼物。

sentences.en: The word gift came up so often.
sentences.zh: “礼物”这个词出现的频率很高。

sentences.en: It really changed how you understood not only him, but yourself too.
sentences.zh: 这确实改变了你不仅对他，也对自己理解的方式。

sentences.en: It was a gift.
sentences.zh: 那是一份礼物。

sentences.en: And all these stories, they felt like gifts to us.
sentences.zh: 而所有这些故事，对我们来说都像礼物一样。

sentences.en: Thank you, everyone, for sharing with us on this Father's Day week.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家在这个父亲节周与我们分享。

sentences.en: I wish we could play them all.

sentences.en: Your stories have had our whole team thinking about what fatherhood means today.
sentences.zh: 你们的故事让我们的整个团队都在思考当今父亲的意义。

sentences.en: How it's changing.

sentences.en: If it's changing.

sentences.en: Because when we asked you about these moments with your dad, we thought there were probably a lot of you who were looking for a deeper relationship with him.
sentences.zh: 因为当我们问及你们与父亲的这些时刻时，我们认为你们中可能有很多人都在寻求与他建立更深层的关系。

sentences.en: Who wanted to understand him better.
sentences.zh: 想要更好地了解他。

sentences.en: We also thought there were probably fathers out there who were trying to do things differently.
sentences.zh: 我们也认为，可能有很多父亲也在尝试以不同的方式行事。

sentences.en: When you asked the question about the moment of when he opened up and what was that for me,
sentences.zh: 当你问到他敞开心扉的那一刻以及那对我意味着什么时，

sentences.en: it's really what he didn't do, right, that told me what the impact was, was don't do that.
sentences.zh: 其实正是他“没做”的事情，让我明白了其中的影响，就是“不要那样做”。

sentences.en: It was like, oh, I'm not going to be like that.
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，我不要成为那样的人。

sentences.zh: 我要更开放。

sentences.en: I'm going to be present.
sentences.zh: 我要在场。

sentences.en: And I'm going to be available to my son.

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, we had family therapist Terry Reel on the show.
sentences.zh: 几周前，我们邀请了家庭治疗师特里·里尔（Terry Reel）做客节目。

sentences.en: He told us all about his own difficult relationship with his dad and how our understanding of masculinity affects our relationships.
sentences.zh: 他向我们讲述了他自己与父亲之间艰难的关系，以及我们对男子气概的理解如何影响了我们的人际关系。

sentences.en: So, as we were listening to your stories and hearing what your dads did well, what you wished they'd done, and the kinds of fathers you wanted to be, we knew we had to have Terry
sentences.zh: 所以，当我们倾听你们的故事，听到你们父亲做得好的地方，你们希望他们做到的地方，以及你们想成为什么样的父亲时，我们知道必须再次邀请特里。

sentences.zh: 你知道，我每天都要处理那些被封闭、压抑、疏远的父亲抚养长大的成年人所面临的后果。

sentences.zh: 父亲节对你或你的家庭有什么特别的意义吗？

sentences.en: It does, actually.
sentences.zh: 确实有。

sentences.zh: 我们会举行盛大的庆祝活动，但不幸的是，我的生日正好和父亲节在同一个周末，所以它们合并在一起了。

sentences.en: But, you know, it's like you're born around Christmas.

sentences.en: But we do, and we make a big deal in my family, Father's Day, and Mother's Day both.

sentences.en: I wish I could show a picture of my grill palace here outside of my home.

sentences.en: I mean, it's a good two-minute walk away from the house, so I go with my sons, and we talk and imbibe, and stay away from those annoying demands that we're waiting for.

sentences.en: You just need to focus on the grilling.

sentences.en: In our last conversation, you told us about your often difficult, very complex relationship with your own father.
sentences.zh: 在上次谈话中，你告诉我们你与自己父亲之间那种往往很艰难、非常复杂的关系。

sentences.en: So I wonder, in addition to the sort of grilling of it all, if Father's Day is also a complicated time for you.
sentences.zh: 所以我很好奇，除了烧烤之外，父亲节对你来说是否也是一个复杂的时刻。

sentences.en: You know, my dad died, oh, heading on 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我父亲去世快20年了。

sentences.en: I've done my grieving and my resolution.
sentences.zh: 我已经完成了我的哀悼和释怀。

sentences.en: I feel like I take the best of my parents in spirit.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我在精神上继承了父母最好的一面。

sentences.en: But my dad, I taught my dad how to be more open-hearted with me.
sentences.zh: 但我父亲，我教会了他如何对我敞开心扉。

sentences.en: It's like opening up an oyster.

sentences.en: I had to prize through his shell to get to him, and I did.
sentences.zh: 我必须撬开他的外壳才能走进他的内心，我做到了。

sentences.en: And on his deathbed, he assembled me and my brother and said, I could have done a much better job with you two.
sentences.zh: 在他临终时，他召集我和我哥哥说：我对你们两个本可以做得更好。

sentences.en: I made a lot of mistakes.

sentences.en: Wow.

sentences.en: So you'll find, and that's where the hanging out part comes.
sentences.zh: 所以你会发现，这就是“陪伴”发挥作用的地方。

sentences.en: If you're only with your kid one hour a week, there ain't going to be an opening.
sentences.zh: 如果你每周只和孩子相处一小时，那是不可能有切入点的。

sentences.en: But hang out with them, and they'll be shut down, shut down, shut down.
sentences.zh: 但多陪陪他们，虽然他们起初会封闭自己，一次又一次地封闭。

sentences.en: And then my son, Justin, he was over our house.
sentences.zh: 后来我的儿子贾斯汀来我们家了。

sentences.en: I don't remember why exactly, but he stayed over.
sentences.zh: 我不记得具体原因了，但他留宿了。

sentences.en: And the two of us wound up in the kitchen at 3 in the morning having a midnight snack, which we both do individually.
sentences.zh: 我们俩凌晨三点在厨房吃宵夜，这是我们俩各自的习惯。

sentences.en: And he looked at me and he goes, Dad, Dad, he's 37.
sentences.zh: 他看着我说，爸，爸——他都37岁了。

sentences.en: Here we are in our underwear having a midnight snack together.
sentences.zh: 我们穿着内衣一起吃宵夜。

sentences.en: How cool is that, Dad?
sentences.zh: 这多酷啊，爸？

sentences.en: That's so sweet.
sentences.zh: 那真是太温馨了。

sentences.en: That's a moment of relationality.
sentences.zh: 那是一个建立关系的时刻。

sentences.en: Underwear eating some ice cream straight from the container.
sentences.zh: 穿着内衣，直接从盒子里挖冰淇淋吃。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: We don't mess with no dishes here.
sentences.zh: 我们这里不用管什么餐具。

sentences.en: When we come back, your questions.
sentences.zh: 回来后，我们来回答你们的问题。

sentences.en: Terry Reel's advice.
sentences.zh: 特里·里尔的建议。

sentences.en: Terry, you're teeing us up so well.
sentences.zh: 特里，你给我们开了个好头。

sentences.en: I would love to move on now to some of the questions we got from listeners who wanted to ask you about fatherhood.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意现在进入听众提问环节，他们想向你请教关于为人父的问题。

sentences.en: Get your advice.
sentences.zh: 听听你的建议。

sentences.en: I'm just going to note that we're going to use only first names in these for the privacy of our listeners who are asking the questions.
sentences.zh: 我先说明一下，为了保护提问听众的隐私，我们只会使用名字。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, Terry, this one comes from a listener named Matt.
sentences.zh: 那么，特里，这个问题来自一位叫马特的听众。

sentences.en: Hi, Terry.
sentences.zh: 你好，特里。

sentences.en: My son Blake is six.
sentences.zh: 我儿子布莱克六岁了。

sentences.en: This morning, he saw a spider and wanted a box to catch it in.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，他看到一只蜘蛛，想要个盒子把它抓起来。

sentences.en: He grabbed the first box he could find, which contained two souvenir wine glasses a friend had just given me as a gift.
sentences.zh: 他随手抓起第一个盒子，里面装着朋友刚送我的两只纪念品红酒杯。

sentences.en: I told Blake he couldn't use that box.
sentences.zh: 我告诉布莱克他不能用那个盒子。

sentences.en: Within a minute, things escalated and he threw a wine glass across the room.
sentences.zh: 不到一分钟，事态升级，他把一个红酒杯扔到了房间另一头。

sentences.en: Part of me feels defensive.
sentences.zh: 我内心感到有些委屈。

sentences.en: He's really a good kid.
sentences.zh: 他其实是个好孩子。

sentences.en: This was just a bad moment.
sentences.zh: 这只是个糟糕的瞬间。

sentences.en: After things cooled off a bit, I told him, he's capable of breaking almost anything now.
sentences.zh: 等情绪平复了一些，我告诉他，他现在有能力打破几乎任何东西了。

sentences.en: Do we want to live like that?
sentences.zh: 我们想那样生活吗？

sentences.en: Do we want to not have any nice things?
sentences.zh: 我们想家里什么好东西都不能留吗？

sentences.en: I told him I was really upset and sad and felt like cutting up our science center membership card so we would never be able to go to the science center again.
sentences.zh: 我告诉他我非常难过和伤心，甚至想剪掉我们的科学中心会员卡，这样我们就永远没法去科学中心了。

sentences.en: He cried a couple tears, then went to his room and slammed the door.
sentences.zh: 他掉了几滴眼泪，然后回房间重重地关上了门。

sentences.en: Did I send the right message?
sentences.zh: 我传达的信息对吗？

sentences.en: When things like this happen, what do I need to do to make real consequences but not diminish our relationship?
sentences.zh: 当这种事发生时，我该怎么做才能实施真正的惩罚，同时又不损害我们的关系？

sentences.en: Thanks, Terry.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，特里。

sentences.en: Oy, oy, oy, oy, oy.
sentences.zh: 哎呀，哎呀，哎呀。

sentences.en: Aw.
sentences.zh: 啊。

sentences.en: Aw, man, been there, been there.
sentences.zh: 啊，伙计，我经历过，我经历过。

sentences.en: Okay, this is called Talk Softly and Carry a Big Stick, but the stick needs to be proportionate to the crime.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这叫“轻声细语，手持大棒”，但大棒必须与罪行相称。

sentences.en: So, uh, you got reactive and it meant, I say this with love, you, um, you retaliated.
sentences.zh: 所以，你反应过度了，这意味着——我是带着爱说的——你，嗯，你报复了。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: Uh, you were disappointed in your six-year-old.
sentences.zh: 你对你六岁的孩子感到失望。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: He was acting like a six-year-old.
sentences.zh: 他表现得就像个六岁孩子。

sentences.en: I get this all the time, you know, in liberal blue-blue Cambridge Mass, I get parents who set limits on their kids and spend an hour and a half explaining it to them.
sentences.zh: 我经常遇到这种情况，你知道，在马萨诸塞州剑桥市那种自由派聚集地，我遇到过一些父母，他们给孩子设限，然后花一个半小时向孩子解释。

sentences.en: And I have to, they, God forbid, the kids should say, I hate you.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，天哪，孩子们竟然会说“我讨厌你”。

sentences.en: You know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: You set limits on your kids, they don't like it.
sentences.zh: 你给孩子设限，他们就是会不高兴。

sentences.en: Good, did he slam the door.
sentences.zh: 很好，他摔门了。

sentences.en: That means he feels safe enough with you to be angry at you.
sentences.zh: 那意味着他在你面前感到足够安全，可以对你发火。

sentences.en: That's good, that's not bad.
sentences.zh: 那是好事，不是坏事。

sentences.en: Mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Your kid's acting like a six-year-old.
sentences.zh: 你的孩子表现得就像个六岁孩子。

sentences.en: Your six-year-old will get angry and reach for something and break it.
sentences.zh: 你六岁的孩子会生气，会随手抓东西然后摔碎它。

sentences.en: It's your job to say, honey, you can't do that.
sentences.zh: 你的工作是说：亲爱的，你不能那样做。

sentences.en: Do that again, and this is what will happen to you.
sentences.zh: 再做一次，这就是你将要面临的后果。

sentences.en: I like if-than statements.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢“如果……就……”这种陈述。

sentences.en: Mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Do this again, and this is what's going to, this is the, you know, nature has neither rewards nor punishments.
sentences.zh: 再做一次，这就是……你知道，大自然既没有奖励也没有惩罚。

sentences.en: Nature has consequences.
sentences.zh: 大自然只有后果。

sentences.en: Mm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Do this, and this will happen to you.
sentences.zh: 做这个，就会发生那个。

sentences.en: And if this will happen to you, it has to be proportionate.
sentences.zh: 而且如果这会发生在你身上，它必须是相称的。

sentences.en: What consequence do you think would have been appropriate in this instance?
sentences.zh: 你认为在这种情况下，什么样的后果是合适的？

sentences.en: You have to go to your room and think about it.
sentences.zh: 你得回房间去反省一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, time out, classic.
sentences.zh: 对，暂停，经典做法。

sentences.en: Without any of your electronics or toys.
sentences.zh: 不准带任何电子产品或玩具。

sentences.en: Think about it for an hour,
sentences.zh: 反省一个小时，

sentences.en: and then I want you to come down and I want you to talk to me about why your dad would think it's important to teach you that when you get mad you can't run around and break things.
sentences.zh: 然后我要你下来，我要你跟我谈谈，为什么你爸爸认为教你“生气时不能到处乱摔东西”很重要。

sentences.en: Why do you think that's important?
sentences.zh: 你觉得为什么这很重要？

sentences.en: That is not a question I was ever asked to contemplate as a kid.
sentences.zh: 我小时候从来没人让我思考过这个问题。

sentences.en: Why do you think it's important to your dad that you not break things?
sentences.zh: 你觉得为什么你爸爸认为你不能摔东西很重要？

sentences.en: Putting, asking the kid to put him or herself in the position of the parent.
sentences.zh: 让孩子站在父母的角度去思考。

sentences.en: Why do you think it's important that in this family you don't get to hit your sister?
sentences.zh: 你觉得为什么在这个家里，你不能打你的妹妹很重要？

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Why do you think we're saying that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得我们为什么这么说？

sentences.en: And you're six, you go ahead and hit your sister, but every time you do, this is what's going to happen.
sentences.zh: 你才六岁，你尽管去打你妹妹，但每次你这样做，这就是将要发生的后果。

sentences.en: Look, here's the thing about parenting.
sentences.zh: 听着，关于育儿，重点是这个。

sentences.en: You cannot control your child.
sentences.zh: 你无法控制你的孩子。

sentences.en: If you try and control your child, they will let you know in jig time just how uncontrollable they are.
sentences.zh: 如果你试图控制你的孩子，他们会立刻让你知道他们有多么不可控。

sentences.en: The minute you look at a child and say, you will not do dot, dot, dot, guess what happens?
sentences.zh: 当你看着孩子说“你不准做某某事”的那一刻，你猜会发生什么？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: What you can control is the environment around the child.
sentences.zh: 你能控制的是孩子周围的环境。

sentences.en: You can choose to do this.
sentences.zh: 你可以选择这样做。

sentences.en: That's up to you.
sentences.zh: 这取决于你。

sentences.en: But if you do, this is what you're looking at.
sentences.zh: 但如果你做了，这就是你将要面对的后果。

sentences.en: And then you have to follow through.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须说到做到。

sentences.en: Here's how I teach parents.
sentences.zh: 我是这样教导家长的。

sentences.en: And when the kid gets older, you can say this, but only to an older kid.
sentences.zh: 当孩子长大后，你可以这样说，但只能对大孩子说。

sentences.en: And look, here's what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 看，我这样做是为了什么。

sentences.en: I am teaching you that you can't behave like that.
sentences.zh: 我是在教你，你不能那样做。

sentences.en: If I don't do that, and you go out in the world and you behave like that, the world will teach you that you can't behave like that.
sentences.zh: 如果我不这样做，等你走进社会还那样做，社会会教训你，让你知道你不能那样做。

sentences.en: And the world will be a lot crueler to you than I'm being.
sentences.zh: 而且社会对你的惩罚会比我严厉得多。

sentences.en: So I know sending you to your room feels cruel to you, but trust me,
sentences.zh: 所以我知道让你回房间反省让你觉得很残忍，但相信我，

sentences.en: it's a lot less cruel than what's going to happen to you if you're 20 and you behave like that out in the world.
sentences.zh: 这比你20岁时在社会上那样做所要面临的后果要仁慈得多。

sentences.en: So go to your room.
sentences.zh: 所以回你的房间去。

sentences.en: That's my job.
sentences.zh: 那是我的工作。

sentences.en: Man, I think that makes a lot of sense.
sentences.zh: 伙计，我觉得这非常有道理。

sentences.en: We have a couple questions that exist in the theme of breaking the cycle, interrupting patterns in families, to put it in your language, facing the flames, facing the fire.
sentences.zh: 我们还有几个问题，主题都是关于打破循环、中断家庭模式，用你的话来说，就是“直面火焰”。

sentences.en: The next one comes from a listener named Sean.
sentences.zh: 下一个问题来自一位叫肖恩的听众。

sentences.en: My father, who is ironically a clinical psychologist, has admitted to other people, not to me, of course,
sentences.zh: 我的父亲，讽刺的是他是一位临床心理学家，他向别人承认过——当然不是对我——

sentences.en: but to other people, that he believes I am already doing a better job than he did as a parent and a father.
sentences.zh: 而是向别人承认，他认为我在为人父方面已经比他做得更好了。

sentences.en: My grandfather was a depressed alcoholic, and so my dad believes that he did a little bit better than his father and that I'm doing better than my dad.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父是个抑郁的酒鬼，所以我父亲认为他比他父亲做得好一点，而我比我父亲做得更好。

sentences.en: But I see already in my kids who are young teenagers the start of some of the same pitfalls and deep, dark tunnels that I stumbled and crawled through in my youth.
sentences.zh: 但我已经在我的孩子们——他们是青少年——身上看到了我年轻时跌跌撞撞走过的那些深渊和陷阱的苗头。

sentences.en: They primarily revolve around being withdrawn, quote-unquote emotionally unavailable,
sentences.zh: 它们主要围绕着退缩，也就是所谓的“情感疏离”，

sentences.en: and this intense fear of being open and vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 以及对敞开心扉和展现脆弱的极度恐惧。

sentences.en: And I don't know how much of this is just being a teenager and how much of this is my own familial or generational legacy that I'm passing on,
sentences.zh: 我不知道这有多少是因为他们正处于青春期，又有多少是我传递下去的家族或代际遗产，

sentences.en: but I would really love for them to not have to go through what I've gone through, which at age 48 I've just started to emerge from in small bits.
sentences.zh: 但我真的希望他们不必经历我所经历的一切，而我在48岁时才刚刚开始一点点走出来。

sentences.en: There's much work to be done still.
sentences.zh: 还有很多工作要做。

sentences.en: But nothing turns a teenager off more than saying, you know, well, let me tell you what you need to do right now so that you don't wind up like me 30 years from now.
sentences.zh: 但没有什么比说“你知道，让我告诉你你现在需要做什么，这样你就不会在30年后变得像我一样”更让青少年反感的了。

sentences.en: So any suggestions you have would be much appreciated.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有什么建议，我将不胜感激。

sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: You have to do this with a light touch.
sentences.zh: 你必须轻描淡写地处理这件事。

sentences.en: Be relational.
sentences.zh: 建立关系。

sentences.en: Push a little, but don't jam it down their throats.
sentences.zh: 推一把，但别硬塞给他们。

sentences.en: But be willing to push a little.
sentences.zh: 但要愿意去推一把。

sentences.en: You know, that's such a sad—
sentences.zh: 你知道，这真是令人难过——

sentences.en: I just got sad listening to you, my friend.
sentences.zh: 听了你的话，我感到很难过，我的朋友。

sentences.en: And, you know, your father telling others that you've done a better job than he.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你父亲告诉别人你比他做得更好。

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess so.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我想是吧。

sentences.en: Otherwise, he would be saying that to you directly, wouldn't he?
sentences.zh: 否则，他会直接对你说这些，不是吗？

sentences.en: Maybe you can help him out by letting him know you've heard that and asking him, Dad, it would be a gift.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以帮他一把，让他知道你听到了这些，然后问他：爸，这会是一份礼物。

sentences.en: Why don't you say that to me right now?
sentences.zh: 你为什么现在不直接对我这么说呢？

sentences.en: In terms of your son,
sentences.zh: 至于你的儿子，

sentences.en: you have struggled, it sounds like, yourself.
sentences.zh: 听起来你自己也挣扎过。

sentences.en: You're emerging now in your 40s from your own walled-offness.
sentences.zh: 你现在40多岁了，正在从自己的封闭中走出来。

sentences.en: First of all, you keep going.
sentences.zh: 首先，你要坚持下去。

sentences.en: I can't say this enough.
sentences.zh: 这句话我怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.en: The best gift we can give our kids is our own healing and recovery.
sentences.zh: 我们能给孩子最好的礼物，就是我们自身的疗愈与康复。

sentences.en: Your son is not going to come out from behind his wall if you're behind yours.
sentences.zh: 如果你自己躲在心墙之后，你的儿子就不会从他的心墙后面走出来。

sentences.en: You can't ask somebody to do what you're not doing.
sentences.zh: 你不能要求别人去做你自己都没在做的事情。

sentences.en: And if you do it, that will speak volumes more than whatever you tell them.
sentences.zh: 如果你以身作则，这比你对他们说的任何话都更有说服力。

sentences.en: So you be open.
sentences.zh: 所以，你要敞开心扉。

sentences.en: Talk about—he's old enough—talk about your childhood.
sentences.zh: 谈谈——他已经长大了——谈谈你的童年。

sentences.en: Talk about your relationship with your father.
sentences.zh: 谈谈你和你父亲的关系。

sentences.en: Talk about a little bit, not too much,
sentences.zh: 谈谈一点点就好，不要太多，

sentences.en: your past toward open-heartedness yourself.
sentences.zh: 谈谈你自己迈向内心开放的过去。

sentences.en: Talk about your relationship if you have one.
sentences.zh: 如果你有伴侣，谈谈你们的关系。

sentences.en: Don't ask him to be open and be closed yourself.
sentences.zh: 不要自己封闭却要求他敞开心扉。

sentences.en: Invite him to be open by always following the cues so you're not overly burdening him.
sentences.zh: 通过时刻关注他的信号来邀请他敞开心扉，这样你就不会给他造成过重的负担。

sentences.en: But here and there, when there's an opening,
sentences.zh: 但在某些时候，当有契机出现时，

sentences.en: show up yourself and be the man you want him to be.
sentences.zh: 展现出真实的自己，成为你希望他成为的那种男人。

sentences.en: Infinitely better than anything you can say.
sentences.zh: 这比你说什么都强得多。

sentences.en: The other factor here which should be named is what's going on in the culture right now.
sentences.zh: 这里还有一个必须指出的因素，那就是当下的文化环境。

sentences.en: And understanding that you are leaning in against the least resurgence of all the least helpful appealing elements of what it means to be a man these days.
sentences.zh: 要明白，你正在对抗的是当今社会对“男子气概”最无益、最糟糕的复兴潮流。

sentences.en: And appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 要意识到这一点。

sentences.en: You're leaning into it, and you're asking your child to lean into it.
sentences.zh: 你正在努力对抗它，也要求你的孩子去对抗它。

sentences.en: You know what you're saying about these other sort of forces shaping a son, a young person's idea of masculinity is really apt to the next question from a listener.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到的那些塑造儿子、塑造年轻人男子气概观念的外部力量，非常契合下一位听众的问题。

sentences.en: This is from someone who goes by Ken.
sentences.zh: 这位听众自称 Ken。

sentences.en: And it's about seeing a kid go down a path that you're not sure about and more directly about trying to model a different kind of masculinity for that kid.
sentences.zh: 问题关于看到孩子走上一条你不确定的道路，更直接地说，是关于如何为那个孩子树立一种不同的男子气概。

sentences.en: Ken writes this, and we've edited it slightly for clarity and brevity.
sentences.zh: Ken 写了这些，为了简洁明了，我们稍作了编辑。

sentences.en: I'm going to read it right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在就读出来。

sentences.en: Ken says,
sentences.zh: Ken 说，

sentences.en: He says,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: He loved dominator games like good guy versus bad guy, but I would decline to play those games with him and redirect.
